            this.x = x;

        if (n > m) {

            n = m;
            m = tmp;
        }

        if (n == 1) {
            m--;
            int[] left = {0, 0, 0, 2, 4, 6};
            long res = (m / 6) * 6L + left[m % 6];
            println(res);
            return;
        }
        else if (n == 2) {
            if (m < 20) {
                println(bruteforce(n, m));
            } else {
                println(1L * n * m);
            }
            return;
        }
        else if (n == 3) {
            if (m < 20) {
                println(bruteforce(n, m));
            } else {
                long res = 1L * n * m;
                if ((res & 1L) != 0) {
                    res--;
                }
                println(res);
            }
            return;
        }

        if (1L * n * m < 1000) {
            println(bruteforce(n, m));
            return;

        long res = 1L * n * m;
        if ((res & 1L) != 0) {
            res--;
        }
        println(res);

                } else {
                    odd.add(new Point(i, j));
                }

                    match[i][j] = true;
                }
            }

            }

            a[i] = a[r];
            a[r] = tmp;
        }
    }

            b = a % b;
            a = c;
        }
        return a + b;
    }

            res[i] = nextInt();
        return res;
    }
    public String nextToken() {

                if ((sum & 1) == 0) {
                    even.add(new Point(i, j));
                } else {
                    odd.add(new Point(i, j));
                }
            }
        }

        boolean[][] match = new boolean[even.size()][odd.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < match.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < match[0].length; j++) {

                    match[i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }

        return 2 * maxMatching(match);
    }

    int maxMatching(boolean[][] graph) {
        int n1 = graph.length;
        int n2 = n1 == 0 ? 0 : graph[0].length;
        int[] matching = new int[n2];
        Arrays.fill(matching, -1);

        for (int u = 0; u < n1; u++) {

        }

    }

    boolean findPath(boolean[][] graph, int u1, int[] matching, boolean[] vis) {
        vis[u1] = true;
        for (int v = 0; v < matching.length; ++v) {
            int u2 = matching[v];
            if (graph[u1][v] && (u2 == -1 || !vis[u2] && findPath(graph, u2, matching, vis))) {
                matching[v] = u1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

        for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            int tmp = a[i];
            a[i] = a[r];
